author: Intel
description:
Go "Behind This Door" at Intel’s Technology Research facility in Oregon. These are the labs where industry-defining concepts like RibbonFET and PowerVia were invented. Intel chemists, physicists, and engineers experiment with chemical materials and electronic components to develop processes that might one day, ten years later, make it to the high-volume manufacturing line. And to get the most out of extreme ultraviolet lithography, they constantly have to be evolving the photoresist material that acts like “ink” to help print smaller and smaller transistors.
